The following JSON is returned if Submission is successfull: [ { "Success": "String", //"True" "Message":"string" // "Submission batch created successfully." "ErrorCode":0 // 202 }, { "CompartmentUIN": "string", "FilterAge": 0, "FluidAge": 0, "CompartmentAge": 0, "UnitAge": 0, "FilterChanged": false, "FluidChanged": false, "SIFNo": "string", "WorkOrderNumber": "string", "Comment": "string", "ServiceType": "string", "DateSampled": date } ]
